response.answer: As Admin, you can review pending leave requests for both students and faculty in the built-in view `v_pending_leaves`, which shows requests waiting for approval [p. 10, p. 19]. The manual says to approve or reject by updating the `leave_requests` record: set `status` to `Approved` or `Rejected`, record your admin user in `reviewed_by`, and store the review time in `reviewed_on`; add admin remarks when approving or rejecting [p. 10].

citations.excerpt:
Students below 75 percent:
SELECT * FROM v_student_attendance_report WHERE attendance_pct < 75;
Attendance for one section on one date:
SELECT u.first_name, u.last_name, p.period_no, sub.subject_name, sa.status
FROM student_attendance sa
JOIN students s ON s.student_id = sa.student_id
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id
JOIN periods p ON p.period_id = sa.period_id
JOIN subjects sub ON sub.subject_id = sa.subject_id
WHERE s.section_id = 2 AND sa.attendance_date = '2026-11-02'
ORDER BY u.first_name, p.period_no;
Faculty attendance summary:
SELECT f.employee_no, u.first_name, u.last_name, fa.status, COUNT(*) AS days
FROM faculty_attendance fa
JOIN faculty f ON f.faculty_id = fa.faculty_id
JOIN users u ON u.user_id = f.user_id
GROUP BY f.employee_no, u.first_name, u.last_name, fa.status
ORDER BY f.employee_no;
6.5 Leave approvals
See pending requests from students and faculty:
SELECT * FROM v_pending_leaves;
Approve or reject (the admin user_id goes in reviewed_by ):
UPDATE leave_requests
SET status = 'Approved', reviewed_by = 1, reviewed_on = NOW(), admin_remarks 
= 'Approved. Get well soon.'
WHERE leave_id = 2;
Use status Rejected  and a remark to reject a request.

cases.question: What are the allowed student attendance statuses?

response.answer: The manual lists the allowed student attendance statuses as Present, Absent, Late, and Excused. Student attendance is recorded as one row per student, date, and period [p. 13]. The database also enforces valid status values automatically [p. 19].

7.2 My timetable
SELECT t.day_of_week, p.period_no, p.start_time, p.end_time, c.class_name, 
sec.section_name, sub.subject_name, cr.room_name
FROM timetable t
JOIN periods p ON p.period_id = t.period_id
JOIN sections sec ON sec.section_id = t.section_id
JOIN classes c ON c.class_id = sec.class_id
JOIN subjects sub ON sub.subject_id = t.subject_id
JOIN classrooms cr ON cr.classroom_id = t.classroom_id
WHERE t.faculty_id = 1
ORDER BY CASE t.day_of_week WHEN 'Monday' THEN 1 WHEN 'Tuesday' THEN 2 WHEN 
'Wednesday' THEN 3
  WHEN 'Thursday' THEN 4 WHEN 'Friday' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, p.period_no;
7.3 Mark student attendance
Status values: Present , Absent , Late , Excused . One row per student, date and period.
